module ResultValueFieldEnsures

type Address is record
    city_id: Integer
end record

type Customer is record
    id: Integer
    address: Address
end record

error NotFound

function load() returns Result<Customer, NotFound>
ensures success
ensures value.id = 1
ensures value.address.city_id = 42
is
    return ok Customer { id: 1, address: Address { city_id: 42 } }
end load

end ResultValueFieldEnsures
